foundation_result: All reported Rocq axioms and SProp definitional UIP are within the unchanged accepted M4 bridge baseline; no new axiom, admission, skipped quotient, parsing-only import or compiler-trust proof shortcut was introduced.
actual_operation_review: PrimitiveDescriptorSample retains an actual global position, nth_error on the fixed full journal, exact native/metadata family + opcode + genuine/intercepted label, before table/flags and the corresponding after actor row.

The generic constructor keeps its explicit indexed observation parameter. Its concrete entry_descriptor_observation chooses the full Frame at THAT plan ordinal and fixes code, origin and before/after object/flag functions; it does not choose a code only from a numeric upper bound.

The native and metadata plan folds advance both the global tick prefix and plan prefix by exactly one operation. Both selected prefixes have equal length; duplicate/equal Tick values cannot substitute a differently labelled call or another plan ordinal.
The ordinary recordedNative/recordedMetadata relations preserve actual Request, Reply, State, origin and ordinal. Their recording label laws refer to every selected Tick at that same ordinal.

entry_runtime_ticks_ordinary is premise-free and identifies the complete source/worker journal with usefulEntryTicks, including the actual final execFrame. MetadataWitness full-frame exactness identifies the same literal data with computed native/metadata effects.
after_map_review: Tick does not encode Frame.after. After-map correspondence is therefore not inferred merely from equal Tick values: signal_frames_exact, tail_frames_exact, marker_frames_exact, status_frames_exact and useful_exec_frame_exact prove equality of FULL frames computed from the actual maintained execution.

Native descriptor effects permit closure, aliasing/duplication and flags changes while retaining object provenance from any previous owned descriptor. The native adapter forces the raw after world to retable only the same child row.

Metadata DescriptorCapabilityEffect correlates a successful fresh open descriptor, object identity, object-map update and FlagsOutside at the SAME descriptor. The strict-to-raw converter reconstructs an actual capability open/local step; it does not pair unrelated existential descriptors.

PrimitiveTableChain composes actual frame.before/frame.after tables: metadata 0->1->0 twice; signal/TRACEME/STOP at table0; setup 0->2->3->4->5->6; actual exec 6->7. Segment appends preserve the identical full middle world and empty ancillary-rights message list of this useful execution.
hypothesis_review: Generic folds expose exact global/plan slice equalities, per-operation effects, concrete ContextSafe, table chaining and nonnegative descriptor decoding. They do not assume private-channel absence, a private invariant, no placement over a whole interval or the entry result.

Concrete prefix/tail constructors discharge those generic frame/code/context and slice obligations from literal data and actual operation order; only nonnegative base task tables remain, supplied by the checked same-source world builders.

The initial decoded descriptor snapshot is proved equal to the actual same-fork C worker table. Out-of-support descriptors and negative machine descriptors decode to no binding; INTMAX bounds remain explicit.

Complete foreign-cgroup observations additionally expose the base foreign-row equality. The useful world suppliers establish it from the same source fixture; it is not a general denial of privileged acquisition.
hostile_case_review: The broad RecordedNativeCapability and RecordedMetadataCapability retain untrusted constructors with arbitrary permitted CapabilityEffect when safe/genuine/supported conjunction fails. Broader Step unsafe/intercepted actions, parent detach/loss and source error outcomes were not removed.

Safe/genuine local classification is conditional. General primitive adapters are not universal no-write claims. The concrete useful worker trace has no native write call; actual source parent grant/committed-loss handling and same-queue read provenance remain separately proved by ProcessQueueWitness and ProcessEntryQueue.

No private-invariant or stable-scope conclusion is hidden in the concrete observation relation. Capability privacy follows by induction from the same fresh-pair/fork birth; source scope is a subsequent consumer of actual recorded placements and table authority.
